note: CORRECTS the ledger's compiled note. The primary broadcast, read cover to cover, shows Studd was a no-show for the announced IP title match; the WWO's on-air president character declares Massacre "the official winner of this match" and hands him the newly-restored IP belt by decree — not by pinning or submitting Studd, who never appears in the segment at all. In the SAME ring segment, Massacre separately relinquishes his own WWO Extreme Championship, framed in his own words as personal ("I need to get rid of something, not only as a conscience..."), immediately after signing a new WWO contract — no narration ties the vacating of the Extreme title to the awarding of the IP belt as one "unification" transaction; they are two adjacent beats in the same segment, not one bout deciding both belts. This leaves the WWO Extreme Championship VACANT as of this date, a fact not reflected anywhere in the currently-held Extreme title reigns — NOT corrected here.

note: The ledger gives no location. This reign (Andros over King $$$ Perfect) cannot be the same reign a 26 May 1997 broadcast (msg_id ylIv784kiMwJ) reports Andros reclaiming. This note narrows r003's own window. It does not change r003's won.date, which stays year-precision. The tournament's own semifinals and final were held the same night, at Battle of the Titans IV (18 Apr 1997). Underground Kingpin beat "Terrible" Travis Lee in one semifinal, Andros beat Jack "Tower of Terror" Harper in the other (msg_id dcyEFh4s03UJ, read cover to cover), and Kingpin then beat Andros in the final for the vacant title itself (r020). This means r003's own 'Andros defeated King $$$ Perfect' bout, whatever its date, is very likely an EARLIER round of this SAME tournament, not a genuine championship reign. Andros never held the belt as champion at all under this reading. He reached the final and lost it there. r003's won.date can honestly be stated only as 'sometime in the Jan-Apr 1997 tournament window,' and its status as a 'reign' (rather than a bracket-advancement record inherited uncritically from the fed's own imprecise title-history ledger) is now in real doubt. Flagged as a structural question for the dedicated WWO reconciliation pass, not resolved by this patch.
